prompt: Every field selector is matching multiple elements within a single product tile and concatenating them. Take only the first match per tile. product_title must be 'Colorations Smooth Silky Sticks, 18 Color set' exactly once. brand must be 'Colorations' once. sku must be 'ALLSILK' with the 'Item #' label removed. Also add a price field containing the current selling price in US dollars as a number.
